basic_info.description: This exceptionally beautiful home impresses with its wonderful natural light, innate quality, excellent scale, gracious character, modern amenities & prime location. Situated on one of the neighborhood's most desirable blocks, this is the kind of house that most people dream of when they imagine living in West Portal. Modern & classic at the same time, the main level welcomes with its large entry hall, beautiful living room with fireplace & windows that bring warm light & charming village views.  The formal dining room aligns perfectly with the well-appointed chef's kitchen & adjacent den that opens directly to the home's deck, gardens & fenced backyard. A full guest bath completes the floor. Central to the house is a handsomely crafted staircase with stained glass feature that leads up to three spacious bedrooms, including the elegant primary with walk-in closet & a separate hall bath to serve this floor. On the lower level is a versatile family/guest room & 3rd full bath, laundry, utilities, storage & 1-car garage space with EV plug. You'll enjoy the expansive backyard with mature plantings, custom stone patio & broad deck to relax or entertain. This enviable home also provides convenience to West Portal shops, restaurants & transportation, parks & schools, 280 & 101 Freeways.
